messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

First draft of the Amendment and Restatement Agreement attached. Headline terms per the term sheet: 12m super-senior new money, maturity to Dec 2029, Facility A margin 4.25% over SONIA with a ratchet, testing holiday to Q4 2026, and the debt-for-equity/subordination of the Aldermarsh loans. Look forward to your turn.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Ironhold - A&R Agreement v2 (Bank mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached. The Bank's principal moves: Facility A margin to 4.50% (from 4.25%); the amendment/work fee to 750,000 (from 630,000); commitment fee to 2.00%; and the super-senior leverage cap tightened to 0.60x (from 0.75x). We can live with the amortisation holiday and the reset grid otherwise.

Alistair

-- Pemberton Rowe LLP
